quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Environs Log
quest.description: While you attempted to move the Pursina's Spike into the frontline mines, you face a significant number of obstacles...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: My, as I should have expected of you, I suppose. Now the dark mud and monsters are gone, with minimal damage to the Pursina's Spike.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I am most glad that you were the one Khedive got to help us out. If it were anyone else, I doubt they could have solved this issue quite so handily.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I am pretty good at what I do.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Indeed, that is plain to see.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: The two miners, Tu and Hao, have headed back to rest. Looks like it'll be difficult to move the Spike back right away...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: But clearing the mud out as we go isn't a good idea either. The closer we get to the area venting the mud, the more intense the rate at which it will just keep flowing out. We have to stop this problem directly at its source.
